summary_en: ASICS approved acquisition of up to 20 million shares (2.82% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 7.0 billion yen through market purchases from September 10, 2026 to March 31, 2027, and concurrent cancellation of 25 million shares on September 30, 2026.
title_en: Notice Regarding Decision on Matters Related to Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 9, 2026, ASICS Corporation's board of directors approved a treasury stock acquisition program and concurrent cancellation. The company will acquire up to 20 million ordinary shares (representing 2.82% of issued shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum expenditure of 7.0 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between September 10, 2026 and March 31, 2027. On September 30, 2026, the company will cancel 25 million shares to address potential future dilution.

The company cited its record-breaking financial performance since 2022 and the significant upward revision of full-year earnings guidance for fiscal 2026, issued in August 2026, as context for the decision. The board determined that, given current stock price levels and after active dialogue with media and capital markets participants regarding the company's growth prospects, the treasury stock acquisition would strengthen shareholder returns and enhance capital efficiency.

The balance sheet as of June 30, 2026 showed 708.9 million issued shares excluding treasury stock and 25.6 million treasury shares held.
